title: DeliveryEvidence
description: One immutable, stage-aware OBSERVATION recorded by Factory against a D113 delivery (D113 clause 3). It records what was observed, not who authorized anything: plan approvals, policy authorizations and owner acceptance are `delivery.decision`, never evidence. This is the successor shape for new deliveries. `factory.evidence-receipt` (v0.25.0) is unchanged, and historical receipts stay valid under it with their original bytes and hashes; a new record may reference one through `legacyReceipt` but never rewrites it. A correction is a new record with `supersedes`, never an edit.

issue.description: Source YouTrack issue; `null` for deliveries not sourced from YouTrack.

stage.description: Evidence stages in D113 order. `implementation` through `merge` are pre-deployment; `deployment` (the verified revision/environment) and `live` (criterion smoke checks against the running deployment) come after it. Owner acceptance is not a stage here; it is a `delivery.decision`.

basis.description: Who stands behind the observation. `machine-observation`: taken from a verifiable producer record (`source.producer` + `source.recordRef`), e.g. a CI run conclusion or a deployment receipt. `worker-claim`: stated by an agent in its report or transcript; a source claim only, never independent proof that the named revision passed or runs, and it can never satisfy a gate by itself. `owner-attestation`: the owner recorded the observation by hand (the only basis the v0.25.0 receipt allowed).

result.description: `unknown`: the producer ran but its result could not be determined (e.g. missing exit status, ambiguous run). `unavailable`: no producer exists or it could not be reached for this stage. Only `passed` can satisfy a gate; `unknown`/`unavailable` block like `failed` but are reported distinctly.

exitCode.description: Actual command exit status when the producer reported one. `null` means NOT REPORTED, never success; a missing exit code never becomes 0.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria this observation covers, each with the stage at which that criterion can be evaluated. A criterion whose `evaluableAt` is `deployment`/`live` is not blocked by, and cannot be satisfied by, pre-deploy evidence. May be empty for stage-level evidence (e.g. `merge`).

branch.description: Branch the revision was observed on (task branch or `dev`).

revision.description: Full 40-hex commit SHA the observation is about. Short SHAs are not accepted. Evidence at a different revision cannot pass a gate for this one (D113 clause 3).

revisionRole.description: `task`: a task-branch revision before merge. `merged`: the integration-branch revision produced by the merge. A `task` observation can never prove a `merged` SHA. `deployment` and `live` evidence MUST be `merged` when `environment.name` is `dev`, and MUST be `task` when it is `review` (v0.38.0: a review environment serves the unmerged PR head, so a `merged` role there would claim a merge that has not happened).

observer.description: Service or person that made the observation.

supersedes.description: Earlier evidence id this one corrects; the earlier record is retained.

legacyReceipt.description: Pointer to a v0.25.0 `factory.evidence-receipt` this record was derived from, byte-for-byte unchanged.

hash.description: SHA-256 over this record's canonical JSON with `hash` omitted.

evaluableAt.description: Earliest stage at which this criterion can be evaluated, fixed in the approved plan.

planHash.description: The approved plan this evidence was gathered under.

issueScope.description: `delivery.issue.scope.fingerprint` the plan was approved against; `null` for non-YouTrack deliveries.

producer.description: Which boundary produced the underlying record. `app-deploy` is the app's own dev deployment mechanism (for `plantpal`, owned by `plantpal`; routing by `runtime`/`gateway`).

recordRef.description: Stable, re-fetchable identifier of the producer record, e.g. `agent-runner:runs/<id>`, `ci-runner:ci.run/<runId>/<jobId>`, `plantpal:deployments/<deploymentId>`. Required for `machine-observation`.

artifactRef.description: Image digest or artifact id, when one exists.

resultHash.description: SHA-256 of the `delivery.producer-result` this evidence was derived from, when there was one.

name.description: `dev`: the integration-branch deployment (D113). `review`: an environment running an unmerged PR head (v0.38.0); its evidence has `revisionRole: task`. Production is outside this contract.

appIdentity.description: Identity the RUNNING app reported (e.g. its health/identity endpoint `app` name), not the configured name.

deploymentId.description: Exact deployment identifier; never just a URL or a branch name.

deployedRevision.description: Revision the running app reported. Must equal `revision`; a mismatch is recorded as `failed`, never as `passed`. Applies to a review environment too: the review URL must serve the PR head.

url.description: Test URL the owner uses (for a review environment, its frontend URL).

hash.description: The legacy receipt's own stored `hash`, copied, never recomputed.
